plan.scope: U04 single-request reference-read deduplication; archived genuine runs, no valid private approval authority
plan.measurement: Each fresh Node worker prepares the same one/eight-run corpus, then measures catalog/view/analyze/execute status once plus five repeats. First measured query is already setup-warmed, not cold OS/desktop startup. No overlapping workers.
plan.acceptance: Preserve original run/task bytes and readiness rejection; same script reads 16 to 2 for catalog/execute status, all scans unchanged. Report all timings including regressions; do not assert a speed threshold or claim full-workflow 20% improvement.

limits: Mechanical queries only; archived control-review authority absent, all runtime readiness stays false.
Fresh Node processes use warm filesystem/cache after setup; not cold startup or Electron acceptance.
First measured queries and all five repeats retained; process-level repeated medians form five pairs, not 25 independent process pairs.
Input parsing, extraction, process startup and corpus construction are outside per-query elapsed times and separately included in worker elapsed_ms.
Instrumentation overhead is identical in both versions; no concurrent benchmark worker, machine background load is uncontrolled and recorded.
A local query timing change does not prove complete Agent/workflow speed, model adherence or M1/M2 acceptance.
